meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一个研究问题,拿到带引用、经过复核的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常遇到需要系统查证、逐条引用来源的复杂调研任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, reviewed report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face complex questions needing systematic, cited investigation

howto.what: 当你说要研究某个问题时,它进入 ULW-RESEARCH 模式:先自己拆解问题、问你要哪种格式的材料,再组建研究团队多波次检索、对存疑结论做辩论,最后给出每条结论都带引用或代码验证的综合报告。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做研究、深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”(含 /、$ 前缀)、“ultradebate” 等措辞时触发;普通提问、调试会话不触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ulw-research 深入研究这个话题
say.note: 它会先问你要 PDF、DOCX 还是别的格式

say.text: 用 ulw-research 对这个项目做深度调查,每条结论都要有出处
say.note: 产出会附引用或验证证据

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究这个问题,并让团队对有争议的结论辩论
say.note: 争议结论须过辩论或进未决附录

howto.what_en: When you ask for research, it enters ULW-RESEARCH mode: scopes the question, asks your preferred format, stands up a team, fans out, debates contested claims, and delivers a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or say “ulw-research” (also / or $ prefixed) or “ultradebate”; ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic for me
say_en.note: It first asks which format (PDF, DOCX, etc.) you want.

say_en.text: Do a ulw-research deep investigation of this project, citing every claim
say_en.note: The output comes with citations or proof.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research on this question and have the team debate contested claims
say_en.note: Contested claims face a debate round or the annex.
